items.title: Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover via Incorrect Authorization
items.summary: A critical vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers to switch customer sessions, hijack accounts, and access private data. Exploitation attempts have been observed in the wild.

items.title: Security Feature Bypass via Incorrect Authorization
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability that could enable a security feature bypass without requiring authentication or administrator privileges.

items.title: Arbitrary Code Execution via Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Arbitrary Code Execution via Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Security Feature Bypass via Incorrect Authorization (Adobe Commerce B2B)
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security feature bypass, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Remote Code Execution in Amasty Extensions
items.summary: Amasty issued a massive security release addressing two critical vulnerabilities in dozens of its Magento extensions that could lead to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Unrestricted File Upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce (REST API)
items.summary: A critical flaw in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any store by using a polyglot (code disguised as an image) to bypass validation.
